description:
Aggregate and browse AI coding agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, etc.) in one place. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.

Codeg (Code Generation) is an enterprise-grade multi-agent coding workspace. It unifies local AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, OpenClaw, Cline, etc.) in a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container — enabling remote development from any browser — with conversation aggregation, parallel git worktree development, MCP/Skills management, chat channel interactions (Telegram, Lark, iLink, etc.), and integrated Git/file/terminal workflows.
This release adds SRN account sign-in and a new Harness Engineering page for MCP servers and skills, adds update-time filters to tasks and hourly ranges to token usage, makes accepting a suggested reply easier on touch devices, fixes a Windows crash and several memory leaks, and updates many agents.
New
- Sign in with SRN, the SpaceRing account, from the new account menu at the left of the status bar, which replaces the quick actions menu.
- New Harness Engineering page in the workspace sidebar, where you can browse the SRN Harness catalog and install, update or remove MCP servers and skills, and see when an install has a newer version.
- MCP servers from all agents now appear in one list. If agents define the same server differently, both definitions are shown and nothing is merged. Edits keep each config file's format and comments, and are undone if a later write fails.
- You can filter tasks by when they were last updated: last 24 hours, last 7 days, last 30 days or all time. The task page and the workspace sidebar share and remember the same choice.
- Token usage now has "Today" and "Last 24 hours" ranges with hourly charts, and the dashboard opens on the last 24 hours.
- A lightbulb button next to Send fills in the agent's suggested reply, so you no longer need the Tab key on touch devices. (#1186 requested by @Fiveo9)
Improved
- Updated Claude Code (claude-agent-acp) to 0.108.0, Codex (codex-acp) to 2.7.0, OpenCode to 2.3.2, Hermes to 0.23.2, CodeBuddy to 2.185.0, Grok to 1.0.89, Kimi Code to 2.6.3, Qoder to 1.1.91, ZCode to 0.88.1 and Command Code to 1.90.0. When a Codex hook blocks or stops a turn, codeg now shows the hook's reason instead of reporting an empty reply. OpenCode's background compaction setting uses the new version's option.
- Long branch names in the branch menu stay readable: merge and rebase actions keep the target branch name visible, and hovering shows the full name.
- The "New files" and "Files changed" lists under a reply use the same thin scrollbar as the rest of the app.
- Updated Next.js and patched dependencies with known security issues.
Fixed
- Fixed codeg occasionally crashing on Windows when several agents run at once, which also stopped every running agent. (#1185, @ana52070)
- Reduced memory retained after closing conversations and tabs. (#1170, #1172, #1173, #1176, @kogekiplay)
- Codex messages no longer run together while streaming. For example, a diagram that followed a sentence directly could fail to render.
- On touch devices, long-pressing to select text no longer opens the conversation menu, so you can copy, quote or ask about the selection again. (#1182 reported by @z91300)
- Building from source now works when Cargo is set to use a custom output directory. (#1171, @kogekiplay)
Note
- MCP, Skills, Skill packs and office tools have moved from Settings to the Harness Engineering page.
- In Codeg Web, SRN sign-in stays off until the server instance is registered.
Thanks to @kogekiplay and @ana52070 for contributing to this release, and to @z91300 and @Fiveo9 for the reports.
